note: kind is push (move the robot furthest), domination (hold the three points; kill_target is the score to reach), deathmatch (first team to kill_target kills, or most kills when time runs out) or range (the shooting range, started from its own menu entry). path_half_length is how far each team can push along the route; the route itself is laid out in map.gd. path_sway is no longer used.

rows.name: Push
rows.description: Escort the robot. It shoves your barricade forward while only your team is next to it. Furthest push wins.

rows.name: Team Deathmatch
rows.description: No robot, no objective. First team to 25 kills wins.

rows.name: Domination
rows.description: Three points, A, B and C. Stand in a ring for 10 seconds with no enemy in it to take it. Each point you hold scores a point a second; first to 300 wins.

rows.name: Shooting range
rows.description: A test range, not a match: targets to shoot, a lane where guns shoot at you, and a board to play every sound.
